coverage.complete_row_definition: structural: every in-scope function has every requested field and explicit unknowns; mechanically_closed and fully_resolved are stricter non-vacuous fractions

method.argument_rule: entry value reaches an instruction read on at least one entry-reachable CFG path before any write; nested calls kill surviving a0-a3 only after their delay slot
method.callee_save_rule: a canonical save candidate stores a value proved unchanged from entry and has a matching reload before any overwrite of that entry-SP slot; outgoing/local stores and ambiguous paired slots cannot close the row
method.delay_slot_rule: transfers execute their delay instruction first; direct entries into a physical delay word require context splitting and are reported unknown
method.hoisted_load_rule: all 22 retained sites are re-decoded as contiguous slt/sltu, add/addu, load, beq/bne idioms by C; the load read is not moved behind the guard
method.memory_rule: direct entry-reachable body stores only: resolved static-index addresses and C-decoded direct $gp stores are named, unresolved sites reuse exact retained region-provenance outcomes, and nested-callee effects are not silently attributed
method.return_rule: dataflow may prove that jr $ra uses the incoming entry value or an unambiguous paired frame-slot reload, but that is only an incoming-$ra continuation; absent external call-link provenance it is not promoted to a normal return. Conversely, absence of such a jr $ra does not prove no normal return because a copied link or other indirect exit remains possible. Both cases keep the return convention unknown
method.stack_argument_rule: load from entry-SP offset >=16 on a path where the same canonical slot has not been written, but only when C proves a call-entry-SP anchor: a same-image static-index direct-call witness re-decodes in C as an exact call target, with no unknown SP state and no positive pop of an unobserved frame. All other candidate loads remain explicit unclassified evidence
method.type_rule: memory-base use proves pointer shape only; exact domains require an accepted retained typed-state binding; call-site constants alone never type
